Embedder

SentenceTransformers-backed code embedder with lazy/offline loading.

Code embedding model with batching and GPU acceleration.

Defaults to a code-specific model (jina-embeddings-v2-base-code) and falls back to all-MiniLM-L6-v2 if unavailable.

Model loading can be deferred with lazy=True so that constructing a tool does not require the embedding dependency or a network download until a semantic operation actually needs vectors. local_files_only=True and cache_folder support fully offline / pre-cached deployments.

Public embedding-provider interface.

Applications may supply their own embedding backend — a locally hosted model, a remote provider, or a lightweight test double — instead of the bundled SentenceTransformers default. The tool only relies on the small surface defined here, which lets callers keep control of batching, credentials, and provider configuration.

class gigacode.embedding_provider.EmbeddingProvider(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Protocol

Minimal contract for an embedding backend.

Only embedding_dim and encode() are required. A single-text embed() helper is optional; the tool provides one when wrapping an encode-only provider.
